paragraphs: Chalafta of Caesarea: Bereshit Rabbah, Vayera, end of section 50. Mattenot Kehunah explains that Caesarea is a place. Chazit Midrash, on “Your lips drip honey”: Rav Huna and R. Chalafta of Caesarea, in Resh Lakish's name. Perhaps he is Rav Tachlifa.
